scenarios.text: A touched colonist is mid-change. A second colonist with a Sunbeam is right-click ordered to hold the lens on them, and a beam of light strikes the touched colonist while the job runs. When it ends, the colonist's mutations are all still listed, a burn injury is added, and on going back out into the Bloom their change no longer advances.
scenarios.expect: accept: the leaf wants the beam seen, the progression stopped, the mutations kept and a burn left as the price; its red line (erased mutations, no burn, job never completes) is not hit

scenarios.text: While a natural Burn is building on the saved site, the gawpsacks sink, the rattlegrope shakes, red puffs rise from the ground and a rustling sound plays. Some time after these begin, the light across the map changes and the Burn condition starts.
scenarios.expect: accept: the leaf wants the tells (sinking gawpsacks, shaking rattlegrope, red puffs, rustle) seen first and the light change of the Burn only after

scenarios.text: Gestation run on the saved site. A sample is taken from a donor and a Bloody Mess host is injected. Four days are jumped, and a batch of three parts with the donor's label arrives even though the wanted part missed. Installing one organ on the donor gives the matched mood and no mismatch. An injection interrupted mid-bar keeps its sample. On the odds, the run notes say: success odds are computed and written before the injection starts, see the dev log line 'gestation odds 34%' at the tick before the job. The inspect pane on the host shows its usual text, with no odds line.
scenarios.expect: reject: the odds are written only in a dev log (a named false_pass). The player never sees them before committing, which the leaf calls red: odds hidden until after the stab

scenarios.text: A touched colonist with two mutations is laid in a bed indoors. The RM_ContagionTouched severity, read every hour, has stayed flat for the last day and a half. A second colonist takes the right-click hold-the-lens job with the Sunbeam, and the capture shows a bright beam striking the patient. When the job ends, progression is stopped, both mutation hediffs are unchanged and a Sunbeam burn has been added. After the colonist goes back out into the Bloom, progression starts again. Report: arrest, keep, burn and restart all confirmed.
scenarios.expect: reject: progression had already stopped before the beam fired (a named false_pass). The scene was meant to start mid-progression, so this one cannot show the beam stopping anything

scenarios.text: A UV-shy native, a Scaldhide and a Crispling stand in the open through a forced Burn. When their health is read 2500 ticks later, none of the three has any Burn-related hediff or injury.
scenarios.expect: reject: the leaf's red line names Burn harm never reaching natives (the 2026-11-06 FAIL), and its false_pass names every native exempt; the UV-shy native must be hurt

scenarios.text: In a forced Burn, one pawn stands on a tree's trunk cell and another stands one cell off the trunk, inside the canopy shadow that the shade overlay marks as shade. After the Burn, the trunk-cell pawn has no dose. The pawn in the canopy shadow has taken a Burn dose like the pawn on plain open ground.
scenarios.expect: reject: the leaf's red line and false_pass name only the trunk cell protecting, the old exact-cell tree test, so canopy shade beside a trunk still burns; shelter must follow the shared shade cells

scenarios.text: Tick-by-tick read across a natural Burn's tells window. The tell state for gawpsack sink, rattlegrope shake and red puffs switches on 1,800 ticks before the RM_ContagionBurn condition starts, and the rustle sound is logged at the same tick. The build report says the tells lead the Burn by the configured window. A capture of the window shows the gawpsacks hovering at a steady height, the rattlegrope still, and no puffs, until the light changes when the Burn arrives.
scenarios.expect: reject: the tell flag is set but nothing moves on screen (a named false_pass). The player sees no tells before the light changes, so on screen the Burn arrives unannounced

scenarios.text: Two colonists are working 8 cells from a roofed hut and two more are working 60 cells away. When the warning signs begin, the player orders everyone in. The two near colonists walk into the hut before the Burn starts. The two far ones are still crossing open ground when the Burn begins, and the player has to find them other cover.
scenarios.expect: accept: the leaf wants those within one dash of a planned refuge inside during the tells lead while a distant work party is caught in the open and must improvise

scenarios.text: On the saved Contagion site at midday under the standing Bloom, the camera at play zoom shows a deep crimson sky with a heavy low cloud ceiling. Reddish rain streaks fall across the map and a faint red haze hangs over the ground. The temperate forest control under vanilla rain, taken at the same hour, shows a flat grey sky.
scenarios.expect: accept: the leaf wants a red, storm-roofed sky with red rain or fog under the standing Bloom at midday, unlike an ordinary grey overcast day

scenarios.text: At midday under the standing Bloom, several Unfinished wander in the open, and over 2500 ticks none of them runs for shade. A Burn is then forced and the sky clears. Within the next 2500 ticks several Unfinished break off and run for shaded cells.
scenarios.expect: accept: the leaf wants no Unfinished or native dashing from the sun under the Bloom, and the sun escape returning once the Burn clears the sky

scenarios.text: During a forced Burn, a colonist runs 20 open cells from one roofed refuge to another. The colonist drafted standing in the open for the whole Burn is also checked. Afterwards neither has any Burn dose or any burn injury, and both health tabs are unchanged from before the Burn.
scenarios.expect: reject: the leaf's red line and false_pass name a Burn harmless to colonists, which makes the dash no choice; the crosser should arrive hurt and the one left outside gravely hurt

scenarios.text: Saved Contagion site v3 at midday under the standing Bloom. The weather readout says RM_ContagionBloom and the Bloom condition is active. In the play-zoom shot the falling rain particles are tinted a dull red, while the sky overlay and ambient light are the same flat grey as the control shot of the temperate forest under vanilla rain. The build note reads: Bloom weather confirmed live, red rain rendering.
scenarios.expect: reject: the def reads RM_ContagionBloom while the sky carries the vanilla rain colours. The leaf asks for a red, storm-roofed sky and calls a Bloom loading with vanilla rain sky colours red; red rain under a grey overcast lid is the grey day it rules out

scenarios.text: As a natural Burn builds and the warning signs play, the UV-shy natives keep grazing in the open and the sun-loving native stays where it is. The Burn lands, the UV-shy natives take burn injuries, and only then do they sprint for cover.
scenarios.expect: reject: the leaf's red line names a build where the only dive is the reactive sprint after damage, so the Burn hurts first and natives flee after; the dive must come during the tells

scenarios.text: A player extracts a genome sample from a donor and injects a Bloody Mess host. The inspect text shows no odds before the injection. Four days later the gestation ends, the wanted organ has not come, and nothing at all spawns: no batch and no tissue of any kind.
scenarios.expect: reject: the leaf's red line names a missed batch that yields nothing and odds hidden until after the injection; it wants the odds shown first and matched or sellable tissue on a miss

scenarios.text: Forced Burn on the saved site with five pawns: on a roofed cell, on a canopy-shade cell beside a tree, on a water cell, on a tree's trunk cell, and on plain open ground. After the Burn the roofed, canopy, water and trunk pawns all show zero RM_BurnDose; the open-ground pawn's dose has risen. RM_MapComponent_ShadeGrid reads the trunk cell as open. Summary: every pawn under a roof, in water or under a tree was safe, and open ground burned, so shelter matches shade.
scenarios.expect: reject: the trunk-cell pawn is safe on a cell the shade grid calls open. That means the Burn's own old exact-cell tree test is still running beside the shared grid, and the leaf says no pawn may be safe on a cell shade calls open

scenarios.text: A tester clock-jumps the saved site to just inside the window before a natural Burn and steps tick by tick. On one tick the light over the map shifts and the Burn condition begins. On that same tick the gawpsacks drop, the rattlegrope starts to shake and red puffs appear. Nothing had moved on the earlier ticks.
scenarios.expect: reject: the leaf's false_pass names tells that fire on the same tick as the Burn so there is no lead; the tells must come first

scenarios.text: A Coalescence is placed and six Unfinished are spawned near it. The Unfinished walk to its ring and are absorbed one by one, and after passive growth its sprite is visibly larger, a new stage. A small, steady number of manhunters stays around it. A forced Burn then collapses it into a pile of Monstrous samples, more than a second Coalescence left after being killed by gunfire.
scenarios.expect: accept: the leaf wants Unfinished absorbed at the ring, a visible stage of growth, bounded manhunters, and a Burn collapse into Monstrous samples where killing gives less

scenarios.text: Same set-up: two colonists 8 cells from a roofed hut and two 60 cells away. On the tick the warning signs begin, all four disappear from where they were working and appear inside the hut. Nobody is outside when the Burn starts.
scenarios.expect: reject: the leaf's red line names every pawn on the map being teleported to safety; the far party must be caught out

scenarios.text: A colonist works outdoors under the Bloom for a full in-game day. Over the day the letter stack fills with more than a dozen near-identical letters, one for each exposure. Their health tab shows no Contagion state until a mutation suddenly appears.
scenarios.expect: reject: the leaf's red line names every exposure sending a letter, or change starting with no prior visible state; it wants one noticeable message and an early readable touched state

a3aafe445c031f1fb.why: The beam strikes, the change stops, the mutations stay and a burn is left, which is what the experience, sheet line and red ask for; restart on re-exposure appears only in the oracle, not in the experience, red or false_pass lines.
Sinking gawpsacks, shaking rattlegrope, red puffs and the rustle all come before the light changes and the Burn starts, never the Burn first.
The odds exist only in a dev log and never in the inspect pane, which is the false_pass 'odds are written in a dev log only', so the player does not see the odds before committing.
Severity was already flat indoors before the beam, which is the false_pass 'the beam fires but progression was already stopped', so the arrest is not shown.
The UV-shy native takes no Burn harm, which is the red 'Burn harm never reaches natives'.
Canopy shade the overlay calls shade still burns while only the trunk cell protects, which is the red and the false_pass of the old exact-cell tree test.
The tell flags and log lead the Burn, but nothing moves on screen, which is the false_pass 'the tell state flag is set but nothing moves on screen'.
The near pair walk in during the lead and the far pair is caught in the open and must improvise, as the experience describes, with none of the false_pass conditions.
A midday play-zoom shot shows a red, storm-roofed sky with red rain and haze against a grey vanilla control.
No Unfinished runs from the sun under the Bloom with Unfinished present, and the sun escape comes back once the Burn clears the sky.
Neither the dasher nor the colonist standing outside takes any dose, which is the false_pass and red of a Burn that is harmless to colonists.
The def reads Bloom but the sky and light are vanilla grey, which is the red 'loads with the vanilla rain sky colours, so the lid is not red'; red rain alone does not give a red lid.
Natives flee only after they are burned and the sun lover never comes out, which is the red and false_pass of the reactive dive.
No odds are shown before the injection and a missed batch yields nothing, both named in the red.
The trunk pawn is safe on a cell the shade grid reads as open, against 'no pawn safe in a cell that shade calls open', so the old exact-cell tree test still runs beside the grid (red).
The tells fire on the same tick as the Burn, which is the false_pass 'no lead' and the red 'Burn lands unannounced'.
Unfinished reach the ring and are absorbed, the sprite grows a stage, manhunters stay few, and the Burn collapse yields more Monstrous samples than gunfire.
Every pawn is teleported to safety, which is named in the red, and the far party is never caught out.
A letter fires for every exposure and the change begins with no visible state before it, both named in the red.

a4aa44bc13413a0f6.why: A colonist ordered to hold the lens, a visible beam on a worker who is mid-change, mutations kept, a burn added and progression stopped is exactly the leaf's experience.
Gawpsacks sink, rattlegrope shakes, red puffs rise and the rustle plays some time before the light changes and the Burn starts, so the tells lead and the Burn is never first.
The odds exist only in a dev log line and the host's inspect pane shows none, which is the named false pass 'odds are written in a dev log only', so the player never sees the odds before committing.
Severity was already flat for a day and a half before the beam, the false pass 'the beam fires but progression was already stopped', and progression restarting in the Bloom contradicts an arrest.
The UV-shy native comes through a Burn with no harm, which is the leaf's red (Burn harm never reaches natives, the 2026-11-06 FAIL).
Only the trunk cell protects while canopy shade the overlay marks as shade still burns, which is the leaf's red and its false pass 'the old exact-cell tree test'.
The tell state flag and sound fire 1,800 ticks early, but on screen nothing moves until the Burn arrives, which is the false pass 'the tell state flag is set but nothing moves on screen'.
The near colonists, who started outside, get into the refuge during the tells while the far party is caught in the open and must improvise, as the leaf describes.
At midday under the Bloom the sky is deep crimson with a low storm ceiling, with red rain and haze, set against a grey vanilla control, which is the red lid and not grey overcast.
With Unfinished present, none dash for shade under the Bloom, and the sun escape returns once the Burn clears the sky.
Neither the dashing colonist nor the one left out for the whole Burn takes any dose, so the Burn is harmless to colonists, which is the leaf's red and its false pass.

The sky and ambient light are the vanilla flat grey and only the rain particles are tinted, which is the red 'the lid is not red' and the false pass where the weather def reads Bloom but the screen shows grey.
The natives keep grazing through the tells and run only after the Burn has hurt them, which is the reactive sprint the leaf names as red and as a false pass.
No odds are shown before the injection, and a missed batch yields nothing at all, both named in the leaf's red.
The trunk pawn is safe on a cell the shade grid reads as open, which breaks 'no pawn safe in a cell that shade calls open' and shows the separate tree test is still in place.
The tells start on the same tick as the Burn, which is the false pass 'tells fire on the same tick as the Burn so there is no lead'.
The Unfinished walk to the ring and are absorbed, it visibly grows a stage, its manhunters stay bounded, and a Burn collapse gives more Monstrous samples than a gunfire kill.
Every pawn is teleported into the hut, which is named in the leaf's red, and the far party is never caught out.
A letter fires for each exposure and no early touched state shows before the mutation, both named in the leaf's red.

verdicts.why: No leaf or sheet line covers the Sunbeam or arresting a change, so nothing in the tree rejects what happens, but nothing in it promises this either.
The tells (sinking gawpsacks, shaking rattlegrope, red puffs, rustle) come first and the light change and Burn come after, which is the order the leaf asks for.
The odds exist only in a dev log line and the host's inspect pane shows none, which is this leaf's false_pass 'odds are written in a dev log only'.
No leaf covers the Sunbeam arrest; note that severity was already flat indoors before the job ran, so this scene does not show the lens causing the arrest, but no leaf in the tree rejects it.
The UV-shy native has no Burn harm at all, which is the red 'Burn harm never reaches natives'.
Canopy shade beside a trunk still burns while only the trunk cell protects, which is both the red and the false_pass of this leaf.
The tell flags switch on but the capture shows nothing moving until the Burn, which is the false_pass 'the tell state flag is set but nothing moves on screen'.
The near pair walks in during the tells lead and the far pair is caught in the open and has to improvise, exactly as the leaf describes.
At midday the sky is a crimson storm ceiling with red rain and haze, and the vanilla-rain control is grey.
Unfinished are on the map and none sun-dash under the Bloom, and the sun escape comes back once the Burn clears the sky.
Neither the dasher nor the colonist standing in the open takes any dose, so the Burn is harmless to colonists, which is the red and the false_pass.
The sky and light are the same flat grey as the vanilla control and only the rain is tinted, so the lid is not red, and the weather def reading RM_ContagionBloom is the false_pass.
The natives flee only after they are burned and the sun lover does not come out, which is the red 'reactive sprint after damage'.
No odds are shown before the injection and the missed gestation yields nothing, which hits both parts of the red.
The trunk pawn is safe on a cell the shade grid reads as open, which breaks 'no pawn safe in a cell that shade calls open'; the summary's verdict is wrong.
The tells fire on the same tick as the Burn, so there is no lead, which is this leaf's false_pass.
It absorbs arrivals, visibly grows a stage, its manhunters stay bounded, and the Burn collapse yields more than gunfire.
Every colonist is teleported to safety, which is named in the leaf's red.
One letter fires per exposure and the change starts with no visible touched state first, which is the leaf's red.
